geometry.coordinate_units_note: CML x3/y3/z3 have no explicit units attribute; contact distances use Angstrom interpretation of supplied molecular coordinates, consistent with input and solvent radius units. No conversion or coordinate repair.
geometry.geometry_role: Matches output initialization, not independently declared optimized/final geometry

reconciliation.reason: Apply only explicit old/new entries matched within half a printed 0.001 cm-1 unit. Remaining entries are not independently confirmed final modes; no final corrected full spectrum is declared.

frequencies.interpretation: Negative signed wavenumbers are source values, conventionally used for imaginary modes; CML units cm-1 do not alone establish the sign convention or a final corrected Hessian.

heavy_distance_comparison.interpretation: Rigid-motion and permutation invariant distribution comparison; not an atom displacement RMSD and cannot resolve site mapping.

completion.interpretation: Parsed finalization properties do not independently establish normal executable termination or geometry convergence.

energy_comparison: ADF cc:total in bonding/decomposition context is not the PySCF total energy; no cross-code energy subtraction performed.
